text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I do a double take at Agnes Tachyon's uncharacteristic concentration.
choice_data_list: Rare to see you so serious about this.
Rare to see you so serious about this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes. Today I am conducting a so-called verification test.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The results of this test will form the groundwork for future experiments. Thus, it is imperative that my preparation be impeccable.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Waaait, what do you mean "rare"? I'm always serious when the occasion requires so!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whether that's true or not, it's certain that Agnes Tachyon normally doesn't behave like this before a race.
